attacks.name: Black Tongue
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Sinister Influence|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance the defender |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Herald of Doom
steps: The defender does not gain |!power| for |!damage| dealt by this attack.
|!wild| |*Throw|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 2 or less, this character may Throw it |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Telekinetic Powerhouse
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!range_large|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Telekinetic Deflection
superPowers.body: If this character would suffer a collision, it may use this superpower. This character does not suffer damage from this collision.

superPowers.name: Mind Over Matter
superPowers.body: When an enemy character targets this character with an attack, this character may use its |!mystic| Defense regardless of the attack’s type, unless the attacking character pays 2 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Incredible Psychic Potential
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 2 additional |!power|.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 7 to 8 on Healthy side, and from 6 to 7 on Injured side.
Stamina increased from 4 to 6 on the Injured side.
Black Tongue's Strength increased from 5 to 6.
Mind Over Matter changed from a Power Cost 2 |!reactive| superpower to an |!innate| superpower that the enemy character can avoid by spending 2 |!power|. It cannot be used for Dodge rolls anymore.
